Dear Brightwater Health team,

Brightwater's reminder services run on the stack I use every day: I have two years of commercial experience with Node.js and TypeScript. At Tessellate Labs I maintain an invoicing service on PostgreSQL that issues about 9,000 invoices a month.

I understand REST API design and web security. I built role-based access checks for our refund screens, and I built chai-check, which flags insecure form actions.

I don't have healthcare experience. I write the rollback before every migration.

Could we set up a short call?

Best regards,
Rania Haroon
